subject: general
question: Who among the following was honoured with the highest Civilian Award 'Golden Jubilee Medal-Civilians' of Uganda in March 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Rajesh Chaplot__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajesh Chaplot** is an Indian businessman based in** Kampala, Uganda.**
 
• He is now the CEO and Director of many company entities in the **printing, packaging, information technology, metal and aluminium fabrication industries.**
 
• Mr. Rajesh Chaplot was recently honoured by the Government of India with the** Pravasi Bharatiya Samman Distinguished Non-Resident Indian (NRI) businessman.**
 
• Mr. Rajesh Chaplot was awarded with **Uganda's Highest Civilian Award (Golden Jubilee Medal-Civilians).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naushad N. Merali**, CBS was the** founder of the Kenyan mobile service** provider Kencell along with French media giant Vivend
 
• **Vimal Shah** is a businessman, entrepreneur, mentor and industrialist in Kenya, the largest economy in the East African Community
 
• **Sudhir Ruparelia** is a Ugandan business magnate and investor of Indian origin. His investments are mainly in the areas of **banking, insurance,** **education, broadcasting, real estate, floriculture**
